common.name: Name
ws.lan_help: Tablets/phones can connect to this URL on the same network
device.pairing_help: Create a device in the admin panel and enter the code shown
device.repair_help: This device lost its Cloud link (token revoked, e.g. after a data reseed). Orders and payments are no longer syncing. Enter a new pairing code to resume receiving orders and printing receipts.
device.pair_error_type_mismatch: This pairing code belongs to a different device type ({type}). Enter a Workstation pairing code.
device.pair_error_generic: Pairing failed. Check the code and try again.
device.unpair_description: All orders, menu, and synced configuration on this machine will be erased. The device will be marked revoked on the cloud. You will need a new pairing code to re-pair.
device.unpair_blocked_desc: This device is holding sales that have not reached Cloud yet. Unpairing now keeps that data on disk — it will re-sync automatically after you pair again to the same branch. Confirm you understand before forcing.
device.unpair_ack_checkbox: I understand there is unsynced revenue. Unpair anyway — the data is kept and I will recover it after re-pairing.
device.unpair_kept_notice: Unsynced transaction data was kept on this machine. Pair again to the same branch and it will sync to Cloud automatically.
device.unpair_done_clean: The device was unpaired and local mirror data cleared.
printer.roles_help: A printer can handle several roles at once. Tick every job this printer should print.
printer.at_least_one_role: A printer must keep at least one role. Assign the role to another printer first, or delete this device.
printer.origin_cloud_help: Configured in admin-web and synced down automatically. Edit it in admin-web; the next sync overwrites changes made here.
printer.origin_local_help: Added by hand on this workstation. Not synced with Cloud — kept as the offline fallback when Cloud is unreachable.
settings.auto_print_desc: When ON: the bill prints automatically on payment (and when a paid order syncs down). When OFF: it prints only when you press "Print Receipt".
settings.auto_print_kitchen_desc: When ON: a dine-in order placed from the customer's phone (QR-table) auto-prints its kitchen + hold ticket when it arrives and on each later "add more" round. When OFF: staff fire it manually. POS-created orders always fire manually.
settings.print_locale_desc: Language for every printed slip (kitchen, hold, receipt). Defaults to the Cloud value (admin-web). Only pick one here when Cloud hasn't synced.
settings.print_locale_hint: Cloud always wins: once admin-web sets a shop print language, the choice here is ignored so every station prints the same language.
settings.print_locale_cloud_overrides: Cloud is set to "{locale}" — your local choice here is currently inactive.
sync_recovery.title: Sync Recovery
sync_recovery.subtitle: Operations that could not reach Cloud. Resolve each by hand.
sync_recovery.throttled_banner: Sync paused — rate limited, resuming shortly
sync_recovery.empty: No stuck operations — everything is synced.
sync_recovery.recreate_confirm_desc: Only if Cloud lost this order. It is verified as gone, then re-created with its items and payments.
sync_recovery.re_resolve_confirm_desc: Use this after you have fixed the underlying data on Cloud. It re-enters the sync queue.
sync_recovery.discard_confirm_desc: Mark it reconciled by hand. It stops retrying and is no longer counted.
peripherals.title: Peripherals
peripherals.subtitle: Register and manage LAN machines (card terminal / cash changer). Synced with Cloud.
peripherals.form_desc: Pick a type and enter the machine's address on the LAN.
peripherals.field.name: Name
peripherals.printer_required: Name, address and at least one role are required.
peripherals.coin_changer_hint: Glory cash changer (via the YRT-R08-MN adapter). Supported models: RT-R08 / RT-RAD-300 / RT-RAD-380
